item.text: The source adds useful detail on history migration, hunk coverage, and receipt recovery. It also qualifies two seed claims: DiffTree updates can replace mappings without replacing the tree text, and the default commit grouping has a size-limit fallback. I’ll keep the publication check at the visible API boundary, since its implementation is not among the supplied files.

Source-grounded qualifications: diffTree.ts:57-82 permits mapping-only updates that preserve the tree revision and provides a single-node fallback above the ASCII size limit. changeSessionService.ts:367-371 can capture hunks when adding a missing DiffTree, so the seed's 'capture once' is not universal. Full hunk coverage is enforced by complete_diff_session (diffSessionTools.ts:72-80), not by validateReady or the workflow service's final ID/status check. For added diagrams, the edge's source owner may be new provided its containing diagram exists in the baseline (changeSessionService.ts:432-438).

The published-baseline check is shown as a handoff: accept() passes savedRevisionId as expectedRevisionId, but acceptCanvasChanges is not implemented in these inputs, so its checks and publication atomicity cannot be independently established. The pinned-source-read promise likewise describes an injected reader whose implementation is absent.
